lessons.title: Networking 101: IPs, Ports & Protocols 🌍
lessons.description: Understand the core networking concepts you'll need: IP addresses, ports, TCP vs UDP, and the client‑server model.

lessons.title: Introducing the `socket` Module 🧦
lessons.description: Create, connect, send, and receive data using Python's built‑in socket library – the foundation of all network hacking.

lessons.title: Building a TCP Client & Server 🖥️↔️💻
lessons.description: Write a complete echo client and server, learning about bind, listen, accept, and data exchange.

lessons.title: Port Scanning: The Connect Scan 🔍
lessons.description: Automate port discovery by attempting TCP connections – build a basic but effective port scanner.

lessons.title: Banner Grabbing: Service Identification 🏷️
lessons.description: Send and receive data to grab service banners, identifying software versions and potential vulnerabilities.

lessons.title: UDP, Raw Sockets & Next Steps 🛸
lessons.description: Go beyond TCP: work with UDP, understand when to use it, and glimpse the world of raw sockets and packet crafting.
